description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- bug: crash when saving an empty note (#12)
- docs: update install guide (#15)
- feature: add dark mode (#7)
- refactor: split the parser module (#20)
- feature: export notes to PDF (#9)
- bug: wrong date shown in footer (#14)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)', grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group: the two FEAT lines (#7, #9), then the two FIX lines (#12, #14), then DOCS (#15), then CHORE (#20). Summaries are sentence case with no trailing period.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add keyboard shortcuts (#31)
- bug: fix tooltip flicker
- docs: clarify the config options (#33)
evals.expected_output: Three lines in FEAT, FIX, DOCS order; the bug bullet without an issue number is rendered as '- [FIX] Fix tooltip flicker (#none)'. No invented issue number.
